name: Kitahama Capital Partners Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kitahama Capital Partners Co., Ltd., formerly Sun Capital Management Corp., operates as a venture capital and private equity firm focused on venture investments, corporate turnarounds and mergers and acquisitions. It looks to invest in businesses connected with ships, automobiles, boiler fuel efficiency and exhaust gas suppression equipment, and offers financial advisory, consulting and brokerage. Dating from 1992, it has its headquarters in Osaka, Japan, with a Tokyo office.
